q1.explanationZh: 文章说这两个“闺蜜”其实是洛阳博物馆里的一对彩色陶俑，她们手拉手，表示是最好的朋友。

evidence.quote: They are actually a pair of painted pottery figurines at the Luoyang Museum.

q2.explanationZh: 沈雨和朋友在网上看到陶俑，马上赶到洛阳，是为了亲眼看看并和它们合影。

evidence.quote: She and her best friend saw the figurines on social media and rushed to Luoyang right away.

q3.explanationZh: 陶俑手拉手，像在说“我们是世界上最好的朋友”，所以 bestie 就是非常要好的朋友。

evidence.quote: They hold each other’s hands and seem to be saying, “Look! We are the best friends in the world!”

q4.explanationZh: 文中说她们喜欢陶俑的传统服装和妆容，还学它们牵手，但没有说她们想知道陶俑是怎么做的，所以选 A。

evidence.quote: Shen and her friend liked the figurines’ traditional clothing and make-up a lot.

q5.explanationZh: 文章讲古代陶俑在网上走红，还让现代女孩模仿它们拍照，所以主旨是古代艺术品变得受欢迎并启发了现代人。

evidence.quote: A pair of best friends recently became famous online.
